name: section46-rescope
cmd: set -euo pipefail; out=${SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR:?}; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$out/install.log" 2>&1; sha256sum kernel/kernel.ts research/track-m/section46-baseline-scope.txt research/track-m/section46-baseline-rescope.txt core/counts.ts core/count-proof-scope.ts core/count-proof-rescope.ts core/count-proof-rescope.test.ts core/count-proof-rescope-identity.test.ts core/count-prerequisite-public.test.ts > "$out/source-before.sha256"; bunx tsc -p . --noEmit > "$out/typecheck.log" 2>&1; bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config core/count-proof-scope.ts core/count-proof-rescope.ts core/count-proof-rescope.test.ts core/count-proof-rescope-identity.test.ts core/count-prerequisite-public.test.ts > "$out/lint.log" 2>&1; for file in core/count-proof-rescope-identity.test.ts core/count-proof-rescope.test.ts core/count-proof-scope.test.ts core/count-prerequisite-public.test.ts core/count-closed-family.test.ts core/count-cert-transport.test.ts core/count-lemma-transport.test.ts core/count-recovery/conditional-proof.test.ts core/count-recovery/conditional-cuts.test.ts core/count-recovery/conditional-check-cache.test.ts; do name=$(basename "$file" .ts); if [ "$file" = core/count-prerequisite-public.test.ts ]; then GDP_WORK_FULL=1 GDP_COUNT_STRATEGIES=1 GDP_COUNT_TIERS=1 GDP_COUNT_PREREQUISITES=1 GDP_COUNT_CLOSING_RESERVE=1 GDP_COUNT_FINAL_DEFER_CHECKS=1 bun test "$file" -t "proof-guided admission checks" > "$out/$name.log" 2>&1; else bun test "$file" > "$out/$name.log" 2>&1; fi; done; git init -q; bunx --bun commitlint --default-config --edit research/track-m/section46-rescope-message.txt > "$out/commitlint.log" 2>&1; bunx --bun commitlint --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs --edit research/track-m/section46-rescope-message.txt > "$out/historical-commitlint.log" 2>&1; sha256sum kernel/kernel.ts research/track-m/section46-baseline-scope.txt research/track-m/section46-baseline-rescope.txt core/counts.ts core/count-proof-scope.ts core/count-proof-rescope.ts core/count-proof-rescope.test.ts core/count-proof-rescope-identity.test.ts core/count-prerequisite-public.test.ts > "$out/source-after.sha256"; cmp "$out/source-before.sha256" "$out/source-after.sha256"; echo SECTION46_RESCOPE_PASS
